items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: But Lee was under contract to Columbia and I did a lot of work at MGM with Lennie Hayden and Lena Horne and whoever happened to be there.

ctx.x: it brought me to the notice of a lot of people. Like, I worked at MGM with Hazel Scott. This was a little later, but I did a picture, I Dood It, you know, which I was so young, you wouldn't even recognize me now -- with Lee Young and I. Lee was under contract to Columbia Studios, which very few people knew. This was before it was fashionable to hire Black musicians, you know. But Lee was under contract to Columbia and I did a lot of work at MGM with Lennie Hayden and Lena Horne and whoever happened to be there.

Did you need an in? Did you need somebody to bring you in? You weren't just hired because you were a good bass player? Were you? I mean, in that time didn't you have to know somebody or somebody make arrangements for you to get the gig? Or not?
